answer: A lockout escrow gates every new identity: its deposit stays sealed for thirty honest epochs before withdrawal, and any duplicate confirmed before expiry forfeits the whole seal to the opal fire. The trigger is graph evidence that two names share one funding root; the rule burns it, so a sparrow-flock of clones from one wallet loses every yarrow bond before earning. Each fake costs 35,000 POA locked plus forfeited rewards, while an honest node matures free.
